import math

# Calculate 64!
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)
print(f"64! = {factorial_64}")

# Convert to string to get digits
factorial_str = str(factorial_64)
print(f"\nNumber as string: {factorial_str}")
print(f"Number of digits: {len(factorial_str)}")

# Sum the digits using method 1
digit_sum_1 = sum(int(d) for d in factorial_str)
print(f"\nMethod 1 (sum with list comprehension): {digit_sum_1}")

# Sum the digits using method 2 - explicit loop
digit_sum_2 = 0
for digit_char in factorial_str:
    digit_sum_2 += int(digit_char)
print(f"Method 2 (explicit loop): {digit_sum_2}")

# Sum the digits using method 3 - map function
digit_sum_3 = sum(map(int, factorial_str))
print(f"Method 3 (map function): {digit_sum_3}")

# Show breakdown of digits
print(f"\nBreakdown of each digit:")
digits = [int(d) for d in factorial_str]
print(f"Individual digits: {digits}")

# Verify addition
print(f"\nDetailed verification:")
running_sum = 0
for i, d in enumerate(digits):
    running_sum += d
    print(f"After position {i}: sum = {running_sum}")

print(f"\nFinal sum: {running_sum}")
print(f"\nAll methods agree: {digit_sum_1 == digit_sum_2 == digit_sum_3 == running_sum}")

EOF
